findings.finding: getCustomerSessionUrl bypasses NetworkService with a raw global fetch instead of extending the shared client for plain-text bodies.
returnUrl is a redirect target forwarded to the billing provider but validated only as a generic z.url() with no protocol/domain/credential/port restrictions.
A local inline ReturnUrlSchema is forked instead of reusing/tightening the shared RedirectUrlSchema.
getCheckoutSession returns space-owned billing data to any authenticated user with no membership/ownership assertion, unlike every other billing route.
Six new authenticated routes with no e2e spec proving wiring (route registration, AuthGuard 401, ValidationPipe 422).
Feature PR bundles an unrelated docker-compose refactor replacing the per-variable environment block with env_file.
AuthModule/UsersModule/SpacesModule wrapped in forwardRef() although nothing imports BillingModule back.
Route service injects the external API datasource IBillingApi directly instead of going through a domain repository boundary.
billingApiMock declares listPlans and getCustomer, methods BillingService never calls.
@ApiQuery({ name: 'status' }) omits the enum, so Swagger does not document the accepted SubscriptionStatusFilter values.
Entity file exports both the DTO class and the toCheckoutSessionDto mapping helper instead of keeping the helper in a dedicated file.

misses.summary: Metadata z.record shape re-declared instead of reusing a generalized shared schema.
Map-spread de-dup precedence inverted (general link overwrote space-specific).
planId/paymentLinkId/sessionId path params unvalidated despite ROUTE-02 covering route-param validation.
De-dup test could not lock precedence (identical objects in both lists).

ruleGapCandidates.observation: checkout-url GET route creates a checkout session upstream (state-changing POST) — no rule covers HTTP method semantics for side-effecting endpoints.
withDashes heuristically re-inserts dashes into 32-char hex ids to compensate for an upstream parsing bug — no rule addresses client-side workarounds vs fixing the upstream contract.
getSessionUrl returns an anonymous { url: string } instead of the UrlResponse DTO the controller documents — no compile-time link between service output and Swagger contract.
